note: Mirror list for the download page. Prefix mirrors get the GitHub asset URL appended; template mirrors fill {tag}/{name}. Hosts must stay on this list; the page re-validates every built URL against it. Policy: only the CURRENT release is served — template mirrors keep just one tag in "tags" and old tag objects are deleted when a new version ships. No raw GitHub direct link is offered: the page is for networks where github.com is unusable.
